{{Quote|Wonderful. We are now part of the tribe.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
[[File:EndorParty-ROTJ.png|thumb|right|250px|The Ewoks of the tribe celebrate after the Battle of Endor.]]
'''Bright Tree Village tribe''' was a tribe of [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] inhabiting a [[City/Legends|settlement]] known as [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="Warriors">{{InsiderCite|110|Warriors of Endor}}</ref> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the tribe joined forces with a band of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[operative]]s in their efforts to destroy a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] that protected the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]], in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. The Ewoks also participated in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], opposing the Empire's [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]] and [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]].<ref name="Episode VI" /> The tribe was led by [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]], who was aided by his [[Council of Elders (Ewok)/Legends|Council of Elders]] and the [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] [[Logray/Legends|Logray]].<ref name="e2">[[Ewoks (1985) 2|''Ewoks'' (1985) 2]]</ref>
